facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 September 2014 a hazard report was recorded on P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
